assembly.f3: Each morning the whole school gathers on the assembly ground for prayer, the national anthem, morning exercise and the day’s announcements. It sets the tone for a focused, disciplined day.

houses.f3: Every student belongs to a house, and inter-house sports is one of the highlights of the year. Students practise their march-past for weeks, cheer for their teammates and wear their house colours with pride.

l1.f2: Races and relays on the school field.
Each house trains its own squad and banner.
Friendly but fierce competition between the houses.

culture.f2: Proud of where we come from.
culture.f3: On cultural day students dress in traditional attire and perform dances from across Nigeria while parents and guests cheer. Drama, debate and talent shows give every student a stage all year round.

character.f2: Growing in spirit and in manners.
character.f3: In line with our mission, students grow in the fear of God and in good character, learning honesty, respect and self-discipline.

hall.f3: The school hall hosts morning worship, career talks from visiting professionals, prize-giving and the yearly graduation ceremony.

excursions.f3_alt: JECK students and a teacher on an educational trip
excursions.f4: Educational trips show students how what they learn is used in the real world. They come back with stories, questions and new ambitions.

graduation.f3: Each year our graduating class walks out in green and gold, ready for university and the world, surrounded by family, teachers and friends.

bus.f3: The JECK school bus brings students to school safely and on time. To register your child, call or WhatsApp the school office on 0913 070 4152.
